## Overview

Rivaroxaban is characterized in the supplied sources as an oral factor Xa inhibitor that may provide more consistent and predictable anticoagulation than [warfarin](./warfarin.md) ([src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630.md)). It is given once daily in the atrial fibrillation population.

## Dosing studied in atrial fibrillation

- A daily 20-mg dose was compared with dose-adjusted warfarin in 14,264 patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation at increased risk of stroke ([src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630.md)).
- A Japan-specific 15-mg once-daily dose was compared with warfarin dose-adjusted according to Japanese guidelines in 1,280 Japanese patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation ([src_81808a7c4c3bf0e34bac1c720768f46d](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_81808a7c4c3bf0e34bac1c720768f46d.md)).

## Development and sponsorship

The ROCKET AF trial was funded by Johnson & Johnson and [Bayer](./bayer.md) ([src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630.md)).
